name: aether-wcag-scanner
description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility scanner with RAG-powered fix generation. Scans live URLs via Playwright + axe-core across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports and returns violations paired with corpus-backed fixes and WCAG technique references.

api_key.title: Allchemy Labs API key
api_key.description: Your Allchemy Labs beta key from https://beta.allchemylabs.ai (sign in with GitHub). Enables corpus-grounded fixes from the hosted insights engine; the scanner itself runs locally. Change it later with /plugin configure aether-wcag-scanner@allchemylabs.
